title: Bach — WTC I Prelude 1 in C, BWV 846

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2011/09/12-5, Tobias Erbsland after Shay Rojansky / Han-Wen Nienhuys). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: LilyPond \tempo 4 = 60 in 4/4, C major. 35 printed bars, no repeats. MIDI last duration is 140 quarters (35 bars).
One printed fermata: the .ly marks \fermata on the final chord in BOTH staves, which is one clock stop at one tick, not two. expectedHolds counts clock stops.
pdf.sha256 pins the Mutopia letter PDF (2 pages). Do not embed document UUIDs.

No ornament signs, so expectedExtraNotes is 0. The final chord does carry \arpeggio in both staves; Cleffy rolls it (arpeggiateChord) while the reference plays it as a block, which costs a handful of onset matches in the last bar. That is a reference limitation, not slack worth pinning.
